test_title: PYST 145: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 01 Feb, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘PEOPLE’ is written as ‘QEOQME’ and ‘MONKEY’ is written as ‘NOOLEZ’. How will ‘SILVER’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• Consonants → (1) is added to the position values according to English alphabetic series
 
• **Vowels **→ No change

So,

 
• ‘PEOPLE’ is written as ‘QEOQME’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e59e6ceab9ee2e236e0e20f7c8eb59687034b0ae3b7c9fae4d82b8e6cb3bb22e.png] 

And,

 
• ‘MONKEY’ is written as ‘NOOLEZ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1a200849a8ef9feedce88e817c16c31faeaef6ed836c2b3092382251f6c1b34.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘SILVER’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/090317614c9ddcf0478299d072fd9164a5113560f1481f066978f0c303be8701.png] 

​Hence, "**TIMWES**" is the correct answer.

99
